style: A professional e-commerce fashion photograph in portrait orientation. Soft, even, flattering light. The model is an adult, fully clothed, in a natural relaxed pose, looking composed. The model is a fictional person, not resembling any real person or celebrity. The garment is the subject: sharp focus on fabric, drape and stitching. No text, no logos, no brand labels, no watermark, no props that hide the outfit.

shots.name: front
shots.prompt: Full-length front view: the model faces the camera, standing, arms relaxed, the whole outfit visible from head to toe.

shots.name: back
shots.prompt: Keep the same model, the same outfit, the same backdrop and the same lighting. The model has turned around to show the back of the outfit. Full length, head to toe.

shots.name: side
shots.prompt: Keep the same model, the same outfit, the same backdrop and the same lighting. The model is turned three-quarters to her or his left, one foot slightly forward, showing how the garment falls from the side. Full length, head to toe.

shots.name: detail
shots.prompt: Keep the same outfit and the same lighting. A close-up crop of the fabric, print and finishing at the neckline and chest, filling the frame. The face is out of frame.

recolour: Change only the colour of the outfit to {colour}. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same model, face, hair, pose, framing, garment cut, pattern layout, embroidery placement, backdrop and lighting.
